result.rationale: Verified from the diff: Admin::EmbeddingController#update only re-renders the @embedding rebuilt by fetch_embedding (OpenStruct with hardcoded id 'default'), persisting nothing. On the JS side, admin-embedding.js defines saveChanges calling this.get('embedding').update({}) (empty props), and embedding.hbs contains only the host table and an addHost button — nothing invokes saveChanges. So the write path is dead code with a no-op PUT route; it's a genuine, specific architecture/dead-code concern grounded in cited diff lines, not an observable runtime defect, so important_non_bug rather than bug
